key_information_units.information: Net sales increased 12.5% to EUR 17.756 million (EUR 15.782 million in 2024), with EBITDA of EUR 1.828 million (10.3% margin) and net earnings after tax rising 42% to EUR 862 thousand (4.8% margin).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief section: 'Net sales amounted to EUR 17 756 thousand (EUR 15 782 thousand in 2024), representing an increase of 12.5 percent... EBITDA of EUR 1 828 thousand... Net earnings after tax of EUR 862 thousand (EUR 605), an increase of 42%'

key_information_units.information: Equity improved to EUR 2.1 million from -EUR 2.5 million in 2021, reflecting strengthened financial position.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Information section: 'Equity has improved by EUR 4.6 million from -EUR 2.5 million in 2021 to EUR 2.1 million in 2025'

key_information_units.information: Net cash turned positive at EUR 0.3 million (from -EUR 5.7 million in 2021) and net debt was further reduced, enhancing liquidity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Net debt further reduced and equity strengthened'; Financial Information: 'Net Cash has improved by EUR 6.0 million, from -EUR 5.7 million in 2021 to reaching a positive position of EUR 0.3 million'

key_information_units.information: Ended multi-year restructuring phase and launched the Vision 2030 Strategic Growth Plan targeting EUR 40 million revenue, 16.8% CAGR, 14.0% EBITDA margin, and zero net debt by 2030; notably, organic growth of 16.8% achieved in 2025 met the long-term CAGR target ahead of expectations.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Launch of "Vision 2030" Strategic Growth Plan in April... setting long-term financial targets including 16.8% CAGR, 14.0% EBITDA margin, and zero net debt by 2030'; Management Comments: 'Organic growth accelerated throughout the year, reaching the 16.8% long-term growth target by year-end — ahead of expectations'

key_information_units.information: Independent valuation by BDO assessed Talkpool's German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million, reflecting strong market position in fiber network planning for Deutsche Telekom.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Independent valuation by BDO put the market value of Talkpool’s German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million'; German Fiber Expansion section details Deutsche Telekom collaboration

key_information_units.information: Pakistan was established as the Group's main production base, delivering cost-efficient engineering capacity for European and American projects and achieving highest-ever local revenue.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Pakistan established as the Group’s main production base'; Pakistan section: 'Talkpool Pakistan continues on a stabilisation and growth trajectory... highest-ever revenue in local PKR currency'

key_information_units.information: Re-entered the U.S. market through a service contract with MasTec in May 2025, marking a step in broader market entry strategy.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Re-entry into the U.S. market through a new service contract with MasTec in May'

key_information_units.information: Announced partnership with Nokia USA on a 5G EME/MEP testing project in November 2025 to advance technology capabilities.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Partnership with Nokia USA on a 5G EME/MEP testing project announced in November'

key_information_units.information: Supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa, securing continued client relationships in the Caribbean.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa'

key_information_units.information: Launched Talkpool AB in Sweden in June 2025 to deliver advanced communication solutions for the defence sector.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief: 'New Swedish Affiliated Company Talkpool AB launched in June to deliver advanced communication solutions for the defence sector'

key_information_units.information: Signed Memorandum of Understanding in April 2026 to acquire Netcom Global Partners, expected to contribute approximately EUR 1 million revenue at a 20% EBITDA margin in the first year.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2026 section: 'In April 2026, Talkpool signed a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire Netcom Global Partners... Netcom is expected to contribute approximately EUR 1 million in revenue and a 20% EBITDA margin in its first twelve months'

key_information_units.information: Secured EUR 1.65 million in funding from ten investors in March 2026, moving the company to a net cash position of approximately EUR 2 million and strengthening the balance sheet.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2026 section: 'In March 2026, a group of ten investors committed EUR 1.65 million to Talkpool... move to a net cash position of approximately EUR 2 million'
